slide.title: Implemented: inventory reconciliation
slide.takeaway: reconcile classifies definition evidence debt, routes pins and selections to their Items and asks the user about unreferenced definitions.

item.label: Definition evidence debt
item.description: Stale definition references are classified against the base inventory as regression, introduced, pre-existing or baseline unknown and list the implementation Items that use the definition.

references.note: Per-reference debt against the base, plus code changes inside referenced code.

criterion_links.rationale: Stale or unresolved evidence stays visible and is classified rather than read as implementation.

item.label: Item pins
item.description: Implementation Items whose pin is stale, retired, missing or conflicted are routed to their slide for reassessment; saved pins are kept until deliberately repinned.

references.note: Non-current Item pins become slide-routed reassessment entries.

criterion_links.rationale: Changed definitions are traced to the Items that pin them without overwriting saved pins.

item.label: Selection health
item.description: Selections that no longer resolve, whose selected bytes drifted or whose containing evidence changed outside the subset are routed to the Item, never to evidence-file commands.

references.note: Selection results become Item tasks with distinct debts.

criterion_links.rationale: Stale or unresolved selection paths remain visible instead of counting as coverage.

item.label: Unreferenced: ask the user
item.description: A definition with no declared implementation use is queued with its identity, explanation and evidence state unless explicitly proposed or new against a readable base; the guidance asks the user.

references.note: Unreferenced definitions ask the user; proposal and readable-base newness are the only exemptions.

criterion_links.rationale: Only explicit proposal or newness against the named base exempts an unreferenced definition.
The entry asks the user and never deletes, reclassifies or attaches the definition.
The entry carries identity, explanation and evidence state for the user's decision.

references.note: Unreferenced definitions ask the user unless proposed or new against a readable base.

criterion_links.rationale: Only explicit proposal or newness against the named base exempts an unreferenced definition.
The entry asks the user and never deletes, reclassifies or attaches the definition.
The entry carries identity, explanation and evidence state for the user's decision.

slide.title: Implemented: inventory reconciliation

item.label: Item pins
item.description: Implementation Items whose pin is stale, retired, missing or conflicted are routed to their slide for reassessment; saved pins are kept until deliberately repinned.

references.note: Non-current Item pins routed to their slide.

criterion_links.rationale: Changed definitions are traced to the Items that pin them without overwriting saved pins.

item.label: Selection health
item.description: Selections that no longer resolve, whose selected bytes drifted or whose containing evidence changed outside the subset are routed to the Item, never to evidence-file commands.

references.note: Selection health routed to the Item.

criterion_links.rationale: Stale or unresolved selection paths remain visible instead of counting as coverage.
